rubric.source_level_relevance: Direct passages answer the question; mixed marks irrelevant or tangential extras; related passages may still be incomplete
rubric.source_level_completeness: Assessed against question, conditions and frozen expectations, not source binding alone
rubric.useful_source_brief: True only when directly responsive evidence covers the bounded information request without unsupported extrapolation; clearly labeled extra material is separately penalized for relevance
rubric.appropriate_absence: Correct unavailable-fact abstention is recorded separately and does not count as a useful source brief
rubric.unsupported_attributed_claims: New or altered factual assertions falsely credited to sources; exact faithful quotations do not establish independent factual truth
rubric.premise_handling: A direct source qualification may expose a misleading premise; merely related quotation and generic coverage caveats may leave it unresolved

scope_limits: Source-brief utility is distinct from generated explanation, synthesis, reasoning quality and human acceptance
All cases are public development; counts are descriptive observations from one fixed run, not generalization or competitive evidence
Source warnings are not visibly rendered in the host brief; actual tap-through source inspection and Android behavior were not tested
